name: Lending — Origination & Underwriting
description: Loan origination system: customer master, applications, bureau pulls and disbursements. Drives the Loan Application Triage Decision App.

datasets.name: Customer master
datasets.description: Retail borrowers across 10 Indian cities. Declared income, existing EMI obligations, bureau score and KYC state. Identifiers are masked at rest (pan_masked, aadhaar_last4, mobile_masked) — no full PAN, Aadhaar or mobile number exists in this table.

columns.name: pan_masked
columns.description: PAN with the identifying pair masked (ABCXX1234F).

columns.name: aadhaar_last4
columns.description: Last four digits of Aadhaar only.

columns.name: mobile_masked
columns.description: Mobile with only the last four digits (XXXXXX1234).

columns.name: monthly_income_declared
columns.description: Monthly income as DECLARED by the customer, INR.

datasets.name: Loan applications
datasets.description: Applications across home, personal, auto, LAP and business loans. Rows with status new/under_review are the live credit queue. Carries BOTH monthly_income_declared (on the customer) and itr_declared_income (income per the tax filing) — the two disagreeing is a real-world underwriting tell that no checklist enumerates.

columns.name: roi_offered
columns.description: Offered rate of interest, % per annum.

columns.name: income_proof_type
columns.description: payslip | itr | bank_statement. NULL means no proof on file.

columns.name: itr_declared_income
columns.description: Annual income as per the TAX FILING, INR. NULL when no filing was produced. Compare against monthly_income_declared × 12 — a large shortfall is a corroboration failure, not necessarily a rejection.

columns.name: decision_reason
columns.description: Free-text reason recorded with the decision.

write_actions.description: Record the credit decision on an application, with the reason and the deciding officer.
write_actions.sql_template: UPDATE loan_applications SET status=:status, decision_reason=:decision_reason, decided_by=:decided_by, decided_at=:decided_at WHERE application_id=:application_id

decision_reason.description: Why — shown to the customer and the auditor.

decided_at.description: Set by the server at the moment of the write.

datasets.name: Credit bureau pulls
datasets.description: One bureau pull per application (CIBIL / Experian / CRIF): score, recent enquiries, active loans, overdue amount and write-off flag.

columns.name: enquiries_6m
columns.description: Enquiries in the last 6 months — credit hunger.

datasets.name: Disbursements
datasets.description: Money actually released against approved applications, with UTR and masked destination account.

columns.name: account_masked
columns.description: Destination account, last four digits only.

name: Collections & Recovery
description: Loan servicing and collections: the live book with DPD and NPA staging, instalment history, the delinquency worklist and every contact attempt. Drives the Collections Prioritisation Decision App.

datasets.name: Loan accounts
datasets.description: Live loan book with DPD, bucket and NPA staging. Bucket and npa_class are the fields collections strategy keys on.

columns.name: restructured
columns.description: Whether the loan has been restructured.

datasets.name: Repayment schedule
datasets.description: Instalment-level repayment history. status=bounced carries the NACH return reason, which is what separates 'cannot pay' from 'did not pay'.

datasets.name: Delinquency snapshot
datasets.description: Current delinquency position per account — the collections worklist. risk_flag marks accounts under dispute, legal hold or skip-trace.

datasets.name: Collection activities
datasets.description: Every contact attempt and its outcome. A promise-to-pay with ptp_kept=false is a broken promise — materially different from a first-time PTP and the strongest signal in this table.

columns.name: outcome
columns.description: ptp | no_contact | dispute | refused | paid | wrong_number.

columns.name: ptp_date
columns.description: Promised payment date, when a PTP was taken.

columns.name: ptp_kept
columns.description: Whether the promise was honoured. false = broken promise.

write_actions.description: Log a contact attempt and its outcome against a loan account.
write_actions.sql_template: INSERT INTO collection_activities (activity_id, loan_account_no, agent_id, channel, attempted_at, outcome, ptp_date, ptp_amount, notes) VALUES (:activity_id, :loan_account_no, :agent_id, :channel, :attempted_at, :outcome, :ptp_date, :ptp_amount, :notes)

outcome.description: ptp | no_contact | dispute | refused | paid | wrong_number.

name: General Insurance — Claims
description: Motor, health and property claims with their policies, filed documents and surveyor reports. Drives the Insurance Claim Triage Decision App, including per-document and per-photo review.

datasets.name: Policies (general insurance)
datasets.description: Motor, health and property policies. intimation_window_days is the contractual deadline for reporting a loss — a claim intimated past it is an exclusion path, not merely a late claim.

columns.name: intimation_window_days
columns.description: Days within which a loss must be intimated.

datasets.name: Claims
datasets.description: Claims across motor, health and property. Rows with status intimated/under_survey are the live triage queue. intimation_delay_days is loss-to-intimation in days — compare it against the policy's intimation_window_days.

columns.name: claim_type
columns.description: own_damage | third_party | theft | hospitalisation | fire | burglary.

columns.name: fir_number
columns.description: FIR reference. NULL means no FIR on file.

columns.name: tat_days
columns.description: Turnaround time in days, once decided.

write_actions.description: Record the claim decision with the approved amount or the repudiation reason.
write_actions.sql_template: UPDATE claims SET status=:status, approved_amount=:approved_amount, rejection_reason=:rejection_reason, decided_by=:decided_by, decided_at=:decided_at WHERE claim_id=:claim_id

decided_at.description: Set by the server at the moment of the write.

write_actions.description: Assign a surveyor and move the claim into survey.
write_actions.sql_template: UPDATE claims SET surveyor_id=:surveyor_id, status='under_survey' WHERE claim_id=:claim_id

datasets.name: Claim documents
datasets.description: Documents and photos filed against a claim. content_sha256 is the content hash — two claims sharing one is the same file submitted twice, which the platform's duplicate-artifact screen flags.

columns.name: doc_type
columns.description: fir | repair_estimate | invoice | discharge_summary | damage_photo | policy_copy.

columns.name: verified
columns.description: Whether the document has been verified.

columns.name: content_sha256
columns.description: Content hash — equal hashes mean identical bytes.

datasets.name: Surveyor reports
datasets.description: Independent surveyor assessment: what they found, what they assessed, and what they recommend.

name: Sales & Distribution
description: Branch and agency network, lead pipeline and booked business. Backs the Sales & Distribution dashboard pages — what we sold, by product, branch and channel.

datasets.name: Branches
datasets.description: Branch network across 10 cities and 4 regions.

datasets.name: Agents
datasets.description: Sellers across branch, DSA, bancassurance and agency channels. Insurance-selling channels carry an IRDAI licence number.

datasets.name: Leads
datasets.description: Inbound and sourced leads. status='new' with no assigned agent is an unworked lead — the ageing ones are what the sales dashboard surfaces.

write_actions.description: Assign a lead to an agent and branch, moving it out of the unworked queue.
write_actions.sql_template: UPDATE leads SET assigned_agent_id=:assigned_agent_id, branch_code=:branch_code, status='contacted' WHERE lead_id=:lead_id

datasets.name: Opportunities
datasets.description: Pipeline and closed business. booked_value on stage='won' is what we actually sold — the number the sales dashboard reports.

columns.name: booked_value
columns.description: Value actually booked on a win, INR.

name: Central Ops — Acme Bank Policy Library
description: Cross-department RAG corpus of Acme Bank's credit policy, KYC/AML and fair-practices SOPs, collections and NPA circulars, motor and health claim settlement SOPs, fraud indicators, grievance redressal, sales conduct and data-protection standards (12 docs). Shared by every Decision App as the grounding knowledge source — every cited answer carries a doc_path + page reference. This is the RULES layer: the SOP is supreme, and anything the app learns from officers sits underneath it.
